_real_world.class: Dual-face (back-to-back) rotating AESA on the foremast (S-band 'mini-shield'), integrated RF mast

_provenance.modeling_note: Primary radar for Type 054B, a dual-face back-to-back rotating AESA replacing 054A's separate Type 382/366 fit (USNI B-tier). S-band attribution and the specific replacement claim are C-only (GlobalSecurity). No public detection-range figure exists at all; modeled between the packet's Type 346A module (052D, larger fixed 4-face AESA) and Type 382 module (054A, older rotating passive array), reflecting 054B's newer AESA technology on a smaller frigate-class hull.

sensor.type.note: dual-face rotating AESA is a radar; Radar is the matching engine sensor type

sensor.max_range.note: no public detection-range figure at all; engineering estimate positioned between the packet's Type 346A module (052D) and Type 382 module (054A), reflecting a newer AESA generation on a smaller frigate hull with a correspondingly lower mast/antenna height

sensor.fov_deg.note: 360 deg: a rotating dual-face (back-to-back) array gives full coverage as it rotates; engine models one merged radar

sensor.scan_period.note: no public rotation-rate figure; engineering estimate faster than the Type 382 rotating array (AESA electronic scan aided by mechanical rotation) but slower than a fully fixed 4-face AESA

sensor.detection_prob.note: no public Pd figure; engineering estimate between the packet's Type 346A and Type 382 modules

sensor.bearing_noise_std.note: no public bearing-accuracy figure; engineering estimate for a modern rotating AESA, better than Type 382 but worse than a fixed 4-face array

sensor.range_noise_std.note: no public range-accuracy figure; engineering estimate for a modern rotating AESA, better than Type 382 but worse than a fixed 4-face array

sensor.track_memory_s.note: no public track-coast figure; engineering estimate consistent with a general-purpose frigate air-search radar

sensor.range_power.note: radar-equation exponent (inverse-4th-power family); standard engine default, not sourced per-platform

sensor.aspect_influence.note: 0.0 disables RCS aspect-angle modeling, consistent with this packet's simplified surface-search detection model

sensor.doppler_notch_width.note: no public MTI/doppler-notch figure; engineering estimate consistent with a modern AESA

sensor.reference_snr_db.note: radar-equation calibration constant paired with reference_range_m/reference_rcs_m2 to reproduce max_range at a reference target; no public figure

sensor.reference_range_m.note: paired radar-equation calibration constant, see reference_snr_db

sensor.reference_rcs_m2.note: 5 m^2 generic warship/large-aircraft reference RCS, engine convention used across this packet's naval radar records

sensor.antenna_height_m.note: no public mast height for Type 054B; engineering estimate typical of a ~147m frigate's integrated mast, slightly above 054A given the 054B's larger hull

sensor.target_height_bias_m.note: no public figure; engineering estimate consistent with the packet's other naval radar modules (horizon-geometry bias term)

sensor.environment_domain.note: surface/maritime domain selected for a shipborne air/surface search radar per authoring standard

sensor.sea_clutter_enabled.note: disabled, consistent with this packet's simplified detection model; no sourced clutter-suppression figure exists to calibrate an enabled model

sensor.enable_ducting.note: standard engine atmospheric-ducting toggle, enabled consistent with the packet's convention for a search radar

sensor.ducting_gain_factor.note: engineering estimate between the packet's Type 346A and Type 382 modules

sensor.ducting_max_bonus_m.note: engineering estimate between the packet's Type 346A and Type 382 modules

modeling_notes: A possible second rotating AESA aft is mentioned as unconfirmed by USNI and is not separately modeled; this record represents the primary foremast array only.
